_readme: 璀璨《璀璨家的空气答案》第1期·层高篇 — 资产批量生成清单。Codex读取本文件后批量出图。所有image_prompt为英文（模型可靠性）；on_image文字为中文（品牌）。文案以本文件为准，禁止Codex自行改写。
episode_title_cn: 装中央空调，层高到底要多少？

brand_spec.style_tokens: high-end minimalist modern Chinese interior, editorial architectural photography, mood of COLMO / Architectural Digest (AD) / 观夏, warm restrained natural lighting, matte materials, palette of deep coffee brown + champagne gold + fog white, cinematic, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, refined, calm, premium, high detail
global_exclusions: any wall-mounted air conditioner or split AC unit on the wall
any outdoor condenser / external AC unit
round or circular ceiling diffusers/vents (only slim LINEAR strip vents allowed)
showroom display stand or product display platform (展示台)
any text, caption, watermark, logo, brand name, signage
clutter, oversaturation, HDR halo, low quality, distortion
single black-line shadow-gap slot vent without visible grille blades
vertical grille bars / upright dividers inside the vent
square cells, checkerboard mesh, perforated diffuser, or square louvers
brand_spec.exclusion_note: gpt-image-2 has NO separate negative-prompt field. Append global_exclusions to every scene/diagram prompt as a natural sentence: 'Do not include: ...'

vent_style_lock.cn: 吊顶内嵌横向长条格栅风口 / 细长矩形 / 内部均匀横向细格栅或百叶条 / 与吊顶一体化融合 / 不要单一黑线式缝隙 / 不要竖向格栅 / 不要方形百叶
vent_style_lock.en: recessed horizontal long-strip grille vent, slim elongated rectangular frame integrated flush with the ceiling, clearly visible closely packed evenly spaced fine horizontal louver blades running continuously along the long axis, NOT a single black shadow-gap slit, NO vertical grille bars or upright dividers, NO square cells, NO checkerboard mesh, NO square or rectangular diffuser louvers
vent_style_lock.apply_to: 每一张出现吊顶或出风口的图（EP01_01、EP01_02、EP01_03、EP01_05、EP01_07）均强制执行；内部百叶必须沿风口长边延伸并呈密集均匀横线。

brand_spec.reference_images_note: 风口参考使用用户本轮提供的前4张图片，仅参考长条矩形外框与内部横向细百叶结构；第5至10张仅参考暖白、木色、自然光与中古松弛感，不复制具体户型、家具组合或陈设。

output_rules.scene_size_policy: All delivered scenes and diagrams are native portrait 9:16 assets; do not create or retain a 3:2 base, and do not upscale or outpaint.
output_rules.clean_variant_definition: For text-bearing assets, 'clean' = the base image / card background WITHOUT any title/label text (chrome like brand frame/hairline may stay). 'withtext' = clean + text composited by code using brand fonts/colors.
output_rules.contact_sheet: Build output/EP01/03_contact/contact_sheet.html — thumbnail grid of every output PNG with its filename + type, for one-page review.

assets.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition. Ultra high-end modern Chinese living-dining room at golden hour, floor-to-ceiling windows with soft daylight, fog-white walls, deep coffee-brown wood and champagne-gold metal accents, matte stone floor, minimalist designer sofa and low table, a single slim LINEAR recessed air vent flush into the ceiling, generous ceiling height, editorial interior photography in AD magazine / COLMO aesthetic, photorealistic, cinematic, shallow depth of field. Keep the LEFT third of the frame as clean calm negative space (for a graphic height-scale overlay added later).

Vertical 9:16 composition. The same ultra high-end modern Chinese living-dining room, a different wider camera angle, calm and airy, fog-white and deep-coffee palette with champagne-gold accents, slim linear flush ceiling vent, warm restrained lighting, editorial AD aesthetic, photorealistic, cinematic. Leave ample clean negative space in the LOWER third for on-screen captions.

Vertical 9:16 composition. Clean isometric 3D cutaway illustration of a modern living room ceiling corner: a localized perimeter ceiling bulkhead (soffit) runs along the wall concealing a slim horizontal ducted indoor unit and pipes, while the CENTRAL ceiling stays at full original height. Minimalist vector-style 3D render, deep coffee-brown + champagne gold + fog-white palette, soft studio lighting, plain fog-white background, premium infographic style, lots of clean space around the object for labels. Absolutely no text or labels in the image.

labels.anchor: upper-left, pointing to the wall bulkhead
center, pointing to the central ceiling
right side, along a vertical gold measurement line

text_overlay.note: Positions are hints; Codex places labels with thin gold leader lines to the correct part of the rendered object. Keep restrained.

assets.reference_images_note: 剖面图内机形状建议另补C2艺境内机产品图做参考（经销商展厅实拍素材中若有可用），当前未提供则用通用风管机比例代替

assets.image_prompt: Vertical 9:16 composition. A finished high-end open-plan living-dining room emphasizing an airy sense of ceiling height, a slim flush LINEAR ceiling vent integrated seamlessly into a clean ceiling, champagne-gold warm evening light, fog-white and deep-coffee palette, spacious and calm, editorial AD aesthetic, photorealistic, cinematic. Emphasize the clean uninterrupted ceiling.

Vertical 9:16 composition. Grand luxury open living-dining room of a large residence at dusk, warm champagne-gold ambient light, a slim LINEAR air vent naturally integrated into the ceiling, elegant restrained decor, strong sense of scale and calm, editorial AD aesthetic, photorealistic, cinematic. Keep the LOWER-CENTER area darker and clean for an end title.

chrome: thin gold hairline under the main number
assets.note: 可选插卡，用在真实产品片段上做卖点强调。不需要就跳过。

rules: 本片落点仅C2艺境190mm，不得跨用其它产品线参数
全片只出线性风口，不出挂机/室外机/圆形风口
不得出现dB噪音数值、App/语音控制、除醛百分比
不得使用绝对化用词或杜撰技术名词

revision.reason: User replaced the earlier single-slot vent requirement with an integrated horizontal fine-grille vent based on supplied references.
